notes.title: Update 2025-07-28: Controller Support and many small fixes
10 Days Till Release and the Deactivation of the Demo
notes.notes:
The Demons Told Me to Make This Game is coming out in 10 days!

I hope you're as excited as we are.

For the full version of the game, we have substantially reworked the saving system. It includes three save slots now, allowing for three playthroughs.

Unfortunately, there's a downside to this upgrade: the saves from the demo are not compatible with the release version of the game anymore. 

This is why we're deactivating the demo. To all who played it, streamed it, reviewed it, or helped us with feedback: thank you so much! Your contribution was invaluable and we can't express how much it means to us.

We hope that a dozen achievements scattered around the prologue Loop will brighten your experience as you replay it.



See you soon and don't forget to
WATCH OUT FOR BEES.



Haunted Dude

notes.title: We Have a Release Date: July 21
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! 

Thank you for staying tuned and for playing our demo! We can't express how much we appreciate your feedback ❤️

We're working full steam now, preparing the game for release. And now, that Steam Next Fest is over, we are ready to announce the release date!
The Demons will speak to you on July, 21, 5 P.M. EEST.


See you soon!
Haunted Dude
